description: A test program for the tuxbox-framebuffer device that tests various display modes and pixel formats, including setting display modes, drawing test patterns, and manipulating color maps.

methods.name: col2pixel
methods.description: Converts a colour to pixel data based on pixel format.

methods.name: setmode
methods.description: Sets the framebuffer display mode and resolution.

methods.name: drawrect
methods.description: Draws a rectangle with specified colour and position on the framebuffer.

methods.name: draw4field
methods.description: Creates a test pattern with four coloured fields.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the program.
